In [[geometry]], the '''parabidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron''' is one of the [[Johnson solid]]s ({{math|''J''{{sub|80}}}}). It is also a [[Midsphere#Canonical polyhedron|canonical polyhedron]].
[[File:J80 parabidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a parabidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]]
{{Johnson solid}}

It can be constructed as a [[rhombicosidodecahedron]] with two opposing [[pentagonal cupola]]e removed. Related Johnson solids are the [[diminished rhombicosidodecahedron]]  ({{math|''J''{{sub|76}}}}) where one cupola is removed, the [[metabidiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] ({{math|''J''{{sub|81}}}}) where two non-opposing cupolae are removed, and the [[tridiminished rhombicosidodecahedron]] ({{math|''J''{{sub|83}}}}) where three cupolae are removed.
